purpose: Supplemental personal-investment research candidates sourced from transcript idea generation and daily Power Stack sweeps. Inclusion and scoring are based on primary company disclosures and regulatory filings, not creator claims.

ideas.name: Hubbell
ideas.theme: Utility T&D + electrical solutions + data-centre balance of system
ideas.thesis: Hubbell is a differentiated grid-modernisation and electrification supplier with exposure to utility transmission, substations, distribution and electrical balance-of-system products. It participates in data-centre load growth without depending on one hyperscaler, GPU platform or power-generation technology.
ideas.catalysts: Multi-year utility T&D investment, data-centre-driven transmission/substation demand, strong Electrical Solutions growth, capacity additions and continued guidance upgrades.
ideas.risks: Premium valuation, raw-material/tariff inflation, margin pressure from growth investments and a slowdown in utility or data-centre capex.
ideas.valuationTechnical: Quality and end-market visibility justify a premium, but entry price still matters. Prefer pullbacks or periods where earnings revisions outpace multiple expansion rather than chasing grid-theme momentum.
ideas.researchNote: Q2 2026 net sales rose 15% with 10% organic growth and adjusted EPS rose 12%. Utility Solutions had a roughly 1.2x first-half book-to-bill, with management citing particular order and quoting strength in transmission and substations from load growth and data-centre buildouts. FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $20.25-$20.55.

screenedOut.reason: High-quality market infrastructure, but insufficient direct fit with the energy, AI-infrastructure and automation architecture.
